pages.title: Titan-Bound Foes
pages.text: Four Dormant Remnants are guaranteed trophies from creatures carrying the matching power.$(br2)$(li)Wither: $(item)oathboundrelics:colossus_heart$()$(li)Ender Dragon: $(item)oathboundrelics:ember_seed$()$(li)Elder Guardian: $(item)oathboundrelics:tide_pearl$()$(li)Warden: $(item)oathboundrelics:nebula_lens$()$(br2)Each of these foes also has a 50% chance to leave an $(item)oathboundrelics:oblivion_stone$().

pages.title: Sky and Void
pages.text: The remaining Dormant Remnants have repeatable hunting routes.$(br2)$(li)Phantoms have a 10% chance to drop a $(item)oathboundrelics:skybrand_feather$(). The Feather also remains rare Woodland Mansion and End City treasure.$(li)Shulkers have a 5% chance to drop a $(item)oathboundrelics:void_pearl$(). The Pearl also remains rare End City treasure.

pages.title: Why Dormant?
pages.text: Every remnant enters the world in its $(l)Dormant$() state. The name changes as it is upgraded, but the item itself remains the same relic and remembers its stored stage.
